messages:
noah: Heads-up: LumaTech signed a 36-month Dedicated renewal and we pushed their IBM Cloud Catalog listing live this morning. Listing: https://cloud.ibm.com/marketplace/apps/lumatech-redwood. They moved 10 services to Dedicated VPC + KMS. Huge strategic win for regulated workloads. :tada:

tanya: Amazing work team! Renewal highlights from sales: committed 12 A100-equivalent GPUs, 35% committed discount, enterprise support, and SSO integration.

ibm-marketplace-bot: IBM Cloud Catalog listing published (Offer ID: LUMA-RW-2026). Private Offer available  PO ID: IBM-PO-55123.

lucy: Legal approved the PO and the case study text. LumaTech signed the public quote. We also cleared the non-prod data isolation language for EMEA.

raj: Support note: Luma requested custom KV-cache tuning, HSM/KMS integration guidance, and help with per-tenant telemetry dashboards. Eng-runtime oncall, please prioritize the onboarding runbook.

marketing-bot: Draft blog + social ready in CMS: "LumaTech scales secure gen-AI inference with Redwood Dedicated on IBM Cloud Catalog." Assigned to lucy for final review (due: 2026-05-03).

noah: Can someone paste the final quote here for the press pack? Finance needs it for the announcement package.

legal: Approved quote: \"Redwood delivered predictable, compliant inference at scale and lowered per-inference costs by ~50% during our peak periods.\" LumaTech gave permission to publish.

finance: Quick note for FP&A: this renewal moves LumaTech from usage-based to reserved capacity revenue starting next quarter. Please flag for ARR forecast.

support: Uploaded onboarding assets to Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/lumatech (case-study.pdf, onboarding-runbook.md, architecture.png). Runbook includes KMS/HSM integration steps and recommended KV-cache warmup.

raj: Also booked a technical webinar with LumaTech engineers for next Wednesday (invite sent). We'll demo live migration steps and discuss latency tuning.

lucy: Early marketplace telemetry: 31 listing impressions, 6 private-offer inquiries, 2 trial activations. We'll share a 7-day digest tomorrow.

tanya: Can product add a 3-bullet how-to for IBM Catalog + Dedicated in docs? Should include Private Offer flow, key rotation steps, and recommended runtime configs.

noah: Great job everyone  big milestone for our regulated-market strategy. Let's coordinate press timing: marketing, legal, and LumaTech to confirm final copy today. :rocket:
